label: Swap Power of Mist and Gas Cloud
summary: Puts Power of Mist on the Floating Catacombs pedestal and Gas Cloud on ASS's Long Library pedestal, so the two relics trade castles.

edits.why: Floating Catacombs relic orb (vanilla Gas Cloud pedestal), horizontal layout list: params Gas Cloud(9) -> Power of Mist(8)
Long Library relic orb (vanilla Soul of Bat pedestal, Gas Cloud in ASS), horizontal layout list: params Power of Mist(8) -> Gas Cloud(9)

vanilla.reason: In vanilla the Long Library pedestal holds Soul of Bat, so these edits would delete Soul of Bat and duplicate Power of Mist; vanilla needs a different swap (Castle Keep <-> Floating Catacombs), listed in vanillaAlternative. vanillaOff (Soul of Bat, 0x0000) is given only so a vanilla image detects as off; do not enable these edits on vanilla.

vanillaAlternative.why: Castle Keep relic orb x=412 y=1220 room-index 0xA, horizontal list (layout 1): Power of Mist -> Gas Cloud
same orb, vertical list (tall room, both lists matter)
Floating Catacombs relic orb x=32 y=128, horizontal list (layout 2): Gas Cloud -> Power of Mist

entityEdits.room: objLayoutId 2 - vanilla Gas Cloud pedestal room
entityEdits.note: vertical-list twin at 0x30BA keeps 0x0009 in o, a and vanilla; one-screen-high room, so only the horizontal entry spawns

entityEdits.room: objLayoutId 1 - vanilla Soul of Bat pedestal room
entityEdits.note: vertical-list twin at 0x3F06 still says 0x0000 Soul of Bat in o and a (pre-existing ASS 1.3.1 quirk, left untouched)

overlaps.detail: Part of the ASS 1.3.1 relic reshuffle (also Force of Echo -> Castle Keep, Soul of Bat -> Olrox room, Leap Stone -> Abandoned Mine, etc.), which is not a listed hack and is kept in both states.

notes: Relic orbs spawn their relic from params & 0x7FFF and despawn when g_Status.relics[id] has RELIC_FLAG_FOUND, so swapping params is the whole mechanism; no code in DRA/RCAT/LIB references these two relics by location. In ASS (o==a here, v->o base change) Power of Mist sits on the vanilla Gas Cloud pedestal (RCAT) and Gas Cloud sits on the vanilla Soul of Bat pedestal (LIB); Castle Keep's vanilla Power of Mist pedestal now gives Force of Echo (both lists). Restoring the literal vanilla placement is impossible without undoing that unrelated reshuffle, so off exchanges only these two params: Gas Cloud returns to its vanilla Floating Catacombs pedestal and Power of Mist takes the Long Library pedestal. Both records sit at the same offsets in o and a (not re-packed by the map editor); if a future build re-packs, locate them by stage/x/y/entity id 0x000B as in entityEdits. Only the horizontal-list entries were changed by ASS; the vertical twins were not touched by ASS and are not touched here.
